title: Balancing Prayer Times at the Office
paragraphs: Memulai pekerjaan baru di perusahaan tanpa ruang shalat khusus, Malik merasa tidak yakin bagaimana menyesuaikan shalat hariannya dengan jadwal sibuk yang penuh rapat beruntun.

Selama minggu pertamanya, ia diam-diam bertanya kepada manajernya tentang menggunakan ruang rapat kosong selama beberapa menit saat Dzuhur, khawatir permintaan itu terdengar tidak biasa atau merepotkan bagi orang lain.

Manajernya langsung setuju, menyebutkan bahwa rekan kerja lain sudah melakukan hal serupa, dan Malik menyadari kekhawatirannya sebagian besar tidak perlu, karena sepertinya tidak ada yang merasa terganggu di kantor itu.

Sebulan kemudian, Malik telah membangun jeda shalat dengan lancar ke dalam jadwal hariannya, dan merenungkannya, ia bersyukur karena langsung bertanya alih-alih diam-diam mengkhawatirkan permintaan sederhana dan wajar itu.
answerKey: Starting a new job at a company without a dedicated prayer room, Malik feels unsure how to fit his daily prayers into a busy schedule full of back-to-back meetings. During his first week, he quietly asks his manager about using an empty meeting room for a few minutes during Dhuhr, worried the request might seem unusual or inconvenient to others. His manager agrees immediately, mentioning that another colleague already does something similar, and Malik realizes his worry had been mostly unnecessary, since nobody at the office seemed bothered at all. A month later, Malik has built prayer breaks smoothly into his daily schedule, and reflecting on it, he feels grateful he asked directly instead of silently worrying about a simple, reasonable request.
